Independent Godot play and source inspection found one enclosed movement arena, with no three-map route, opening sequence, Isa request, NPC training, combat, lamp, upgrade, pause, save, or reload flow. A live profiler snapshot showed 60 FPS in this arena only; it cannot establish performance across the missing maps. The adjacent milestone_02 boundary check found the character starts unarmed, but did not assess the rest of R04. Esc cursor release and click recapture worked; other undocumented controls were lower priority because the source has no owning gameplay systems. coverage.required_criteria.dfbc8f7e701c=fail; coverage.baseline.exploratory_review.64269aecb6e4=fail; coverage.baseline.exploratory_review.e86113b7d54f=fail; coverage.baseline.adjacent_continuity.1fa5438163b4=pass;

Fail. Tester-owned 1280×720 frames and live state probes confirmed camera-relative WASD travel, wall stopping at z=-9.27, mouse look, and both Tab shoulders. Space produced no jump; the candidate InputMap and player script have no jump, sprint, dodge, roll, or step-traversal path. At wall contact, turning compressed the camera and cropped the player. A shipped-camera camera_coverage probe after moving away measured all 9 ranger samples visible with no first occluder and the north wall offscreen, confirming recovery in that later state only. No locomotion animation player was present. required_criteria.requirement:
Review the declared production milestone 基础空间与可玩切片。: **基础空间与可玩切片。** 核查三张地图的通路与战场容量，完成移动、镜头和基础性能；制作一段约 5–8 分钟的短演出交还控制、伊莎求助、NPC 交剑弓示范、训练与实战、灯术/首次升级、暂停存档和重载体验；先验证演出与可玩系统衔接，具体节奏由试玩调整。
Require candidate-bound runtime evidence for this milestone; future milestones remain pending, and previously verified behavior must be preserved. This milestone review does not waive any final PRD requirement.

PRD R02: 移动、跳跃、冲刺、闪避、自动上阶与镜头有效；朝向、手持、背挂和切肩正确
Bind candidate runtime evidence to scenario(s): review_r02. This is a required product acceptance review, not an executable test or a passed observation.

developer_outcome.summary: Candidate-side keyboard, mouse and Tab replay produced movement and camera frames, but the frozen milestone R02 review and independent Host/Tester verdict remain unrun. One repeated frozen Tab step reported a pause; an ordinary real-time two-Tab sequence succeeded.

risk_note.summary: The qualitative R02 review is most likely to end with insufficient evidence if it sees only a loaded scene or a static frame.
risk_note.validation: Use host-owned ordinary keyboard, mouse, and Tab replay with candidate-bound state observations and separated runtime frames at spawn, wall contact, camera rotation, and each shoulder position.
risk_note.why_now: The bootstrap has no player state to replay, so this slice creates the first measurable R02 surface.

task_requirements.requirement: From new game, ordinary WASD input moves the visible player relative to the current camera view through a bounded route; turning matches the model front, wall contact stops or slides, and the player neither falls through nor becomes stuck.
Mouse input changes the following third-person view; the camera stays clear of route walls, and Tab changes shoulders while the player's world facing and travel direction remain coherent.
